items: A slab projecting from the wall's outer face with a railing on three sides.
A flat plate over an entrance; h_drop lets the outer edge fall for drainage.
A sloped plate over a shopfront or a window, angle in degrees below horizontal.
A horizontal band projecting from the wall — the eaves line of a Dutch facade.
A shallow pier standing proud of the wall; set them every 3 m for a rhythm.
Vertical sun fins covering a whole wall panel, one fin every `spacing` metres.
A horizontal brise-soleil: `slats` blades spread over the projection depth.
A thin band of brick or stone marking a floor line.
A coping stone straddling the top of a parapet wall.
